title: Customer Probing & Clarity Scorer for Hosted API Streaming/Toolcalls
creator: Ana Ramirez
description: Create a lightweight but systematic playbook and automated clarity scorer to triage incoming Hosted API feature requests that involve chat, streaming, tool/function calling, or structured outputs. The goal is to reduce manual back-and-forth with customers, give fast, consistent routing decisions (Fast-Ship / Evaluate / Enterprise-Engage / Needs Security Review / Decline), and produce a small set of deterministic signals for PM/Eng/Sales/Support to act on. Deliverables: 1) 10-question customer-facing probing form; 2) backend scoring mapping with weights and thresholds; 3) Slack + intake-service routing rules; 4) triage dashboard (signals + score distribution); 5) operator playbook for follow-ups and escalation. Out of scope: full automation of contractual negotiation and Dedicated capacity provisioning (we will surface signals and hand off to Sales/SE).

acceptance_criteria: A compact 10-question probing form with field-level help deployed to the intake-service and accessible to Sales/Support.
A server-side clarity scorer that returns a numeric score (0-100) and one of the routing buckets: Fast-Ship, Evaluate, Enterprise-Engage, Needs-Security-Review, Decline.
Routing rules wired to Slack notifications and an intake dashboard that shows score distribution, top failing signals, and pending Security reviews.
A short operator playbook in Confluence describing follow-up templates, expected SLAs per bucket, and how to escalate to Solutions/Eng/Legal.
Engineering and Security have reviewed the scoring thresholds and signed off on 'Needs-Security-Review' gating conditions.
decisions: Use a weighted score with integer weights totaling 100: SLA(30) + Data sensitivity(20) + Integration complexity(20) + Monthly token estimate(15) + Strategic value(15).
Thresholds: >=75 => Enterprise-Engage, 50-74 => Evaluate, 25-49 => Fast-Ship candidate (low-touch), <25 => Decline/No-Work. Any 'regulated' data flag overrides and forces Needs-Security-Review.
Include an explicit 'Requires Dedicated or Private' checkbox; checking this sets a hard dependency to route to Sales + Solutions even if score is low.
Expose the raw signals to PM and ENG in the triage dashboard to allow manual override with audit trail.

clarity_questionnaire: 1) What is the primary feature you want to enable (chat, streaming, tool-calling, structured output)? Provide 2-3 example user flows.
2) What is the expected throughput (concurrent sessions / requests per minute)?
3) What latency SLO is required (p95 target in ms)?
4) Where will customer data be processed/stored (public cloud / VPC / on-prem / regulated)?
5) Does the customer require model pinning, custom fine-tuning, or parameterizable model behavior?
6) Do tool/function calls require third-party connectors or private adapters?
7) Estimated monthly token usage (approx order of magnitude).
8) Business impact / dollar value tied to the feature (qualitative or rough estimate).
9) Does the request include contract, compliance, or audit requirements (SOC2, HIPAA, PCI)?
scoring_examples: Example A: Customer requests streaming chat for internal knowledge bot, 2000 concurrent sessions, p95 300ms, public cloud, monthly tokens 50M, not regulated => Score calculation: SLA(15/30) + Data(5/20) + Complexity(10/20) + Tokens(10/15) + ROI(10/15) = 50 => Evaluate bucket.

Example B: Early-stage startup wants a simple text-generation endpoint with no tool-calling, low throughput, p95 1s, public cloud, tokens 1M => Score ~18 => Fast-Ship candidate (low-touch onboarding).

Example C: Enterprise customer requires streaming toolchains tied to internal CRM, regulated data, and Dedicated tenancy checkbox checked => Triggers Needs-Security-Review + route to Enterprise-Engage regardless of numeric score.
routing_recommendations: Fast-Ship: PM triage approves, CS/Sales given canned onboarding checklist and self-serve docs; target time-to-first-success < 7 days.
Evaluate: Assign Solutions Engineer for a scoping call; generate an ENG estimate; target decision within 2 sprints.
Enterprise-Engage: Sales + Solutions + Legal looped in; open a dedicated intake ticket and schedule architecture review; prepare pricing and SLA proposal.
Needs-Security-Review: Security performs an intake review within 3 business days; block movement to Enterprise-Engage until approved.
Decline: Provide clear rationale and possible low-effort alternatives (e.g., demo of hosted features).
